O divine Varuṇa, whatever vow of yours we, like ordinary men, transgress day after day; whatever offence we humans commit against the divine host, O Varuṇa; whatever law of yours we have broken through heedlessness: do not harm us, O god, for that sin.

Whatever sin gamblers have cast upon us as a false charge, whatever we have truly committed, and whatever we have done unknowingly, cast all these away from us, O god, as if loosened; then, O Varuṇa, may we be dear to you.
